title: Should the UK capital’s higher ed institutions be ‘Londonmaxxing’?

title: From exam leaks to a national movement: Inside the protests reshaping India’s education debate
summary_en: What began as outrage over the alleged NEET paper leak has evolved into a nationwide student protest movement. Reporting from Mumbai, The PIE explores why students say the crisis has become about far more than one examination or one minister.
